review_candidates.title: Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description A.M.R. TRADING is a specialized industrial equipment distributor representing leading European manufacturers in welding and metalworking technologies. The company is the local representative of Kemppi (Finland), a global producer of advanced inverter welding machines, and collaborates with partners in Holland, Germany, Belgium, and other countries. Its portfolio includes sheet metal working machines, CNC lathes, machining centers, welding curtains, torches, consumables, plasma cutting machines, welding electrodes, and suction and filtering systems. A.M.R. TRADING serves customers who require reliable, high-technology solutions for professional welding and metal fabrication. Team members work closely with international partners and local clients to provide technical solutions that meet diverse industrial needs. Role Description The Sales Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Qesm El Maadi. This role is responsible for promoting and selling welding, metalworking, and CNC solutions to industrial customers, including conducting product demonstrations and technical presentations. The Sales Engineer will assess customer requirements, prepare proposals and quotations, and follow up on opportunities to close deals and achieve sales targets. Day-to-day tasks include providing technical support before and after sales, coordinating with suppliers, and assisting customers with equipment specifications, installation guidance, and troubleshooting. The role also involves maintaining strong customer relationships, visiting client sites, collecting market feedback, and preparing regular sales and activity reports. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and technical understanding skills related to welding, metalworking, and CNC equipment. Candidates should possess solid Sales and Customer Service skills to manage pipelines, close deals, and build long-term client relationships. Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to deliver clear product explanations, technical presentations, and written proposals. Candidates should ideally have prior experience in technical support or field service for industrial machinery or similar products. Relevant technical education (e.g., Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering diploma or degree) is highly beneficial. Ability to work on-site, visit customer locations, and manage multiple opportunities in parallel. Good command of English for communicating with international suppliers and preparing documentation. Strong problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new technologies and products.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Location: Remote with Sheffield HQ visits 6 times a year Annual Salary: £60,000- £75,000 We are currently looking for two Senior Software Engineers (Backend Focus) to join our team Join Our Engineering Evolution at Twinkl At Twinkl, we're not just building software - we're transforming how millions of educators and learners interact with educational content and resources worldwide. We offer a unique proposition: the massive global scale of an established educational publisher combined with the agile technological footprint needed to accelerate that mission. Backed by equity partners who are actively invested in our growth, we are expanding into high-value global markets, making this a pivotal time to join our journey. We are in the midst of an exciting transformation, rebuilding our core platform from the ground up using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js alongside serverless AWS cloud architecture. Crucially, we do this within a genuinely collaborative, supportive, and inclusive team environment. We believe that everyone in the room has a voice, every opinion carries weight, and every engineer has the opportunity to drive impact. We trust our teams to make the right technical decisions and own their solutions in a safe, open setting. What will you be doing? Technical Architecture & Delivery: Partner closely with our existing Senior Engineer and Engineering Manager to lead system design, re-architecture, and delivery across key platform initiatives. Coaching & Mentorship: Act as a supportive mentor for the team, coaching engineers through technical challenges and helping them upskill as they get familiar with our replatformed tech stack and architectural patterns. AI-Integrated Engineering: Utilise modern AI tools as an everyday part of your development workflow. We actively embrace AI across the organisation and are rolling out Claude to enhance productivity, code quality, and technical experimentation. Building Scalable Backend Systems: Re-architect legacy areas of our platform into modern, serverless microservices that deliver educational tools to teachers and students across every time zone. Fostering an Inclusive Culture: Help maintain an open, psychologically safe environment where team members feel confident speaking up, sharing ideas, and collaborating openly. You’ll use our tech stack.. Node.js + TypeScript as your primary focus for backend services and API design AWS Cloud Services (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS) for serverless and microservices architecture React + Next.js + TypeScript across the full stack when required Terraform (IaC) & GitHub Actions for continuous deployment Vitest, React Testing Library, & Playwright for unit, integration, and end-to-end testing to craft web applications and digital products that have real impact. Our engineers genuinely care about education and the global user base we serve. As part of our major re-platforming effort, you won't just be maintaining code - you’ll be rebuilding critical core infrastructure to ensure our systems can scale seamlessly for millions of educators and learners worldwide. What do we need from you? Backend Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience in backend engineering and architecture using Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS cloud services. Full-Stack Competency: Comfort working across the entire stack (including React and Next.js) when needed, with a clear primary passion for backend architecture. Coaching & Team Mentorship: Strong passion for mentoring, pair programming, and helping fellow engineers grow their technical skill sets. Collaborative Senior Leadership: Ability to partner effectively with another Senior Engineer and the Engineering Manager on system design, technical roadmaps, and execution. Inclusive Mindset: An empathetic, open communication style that thrives in a workplace where everyone’s voice matters and collaborative problem-solving is prioritised. Modern SDLC & AI Tools: Proven experience with automated testing, TDD, and CI/CD pipelines, combined with enthusiasm for using AI tools (such as Claude) to optimise daily development. What’s in it for you? A friendly, welcoming and supportive culture. We believe work should be fun and always put people before process Flexible working with fully remote and hybrid working options 33 days annual leave per year, pro rata. You decide which public holidays to recognise. After 2 years of employment, your annual leave entitlement will accrue year on year up to 38 days annual leave An additional day of annual leave, a Me Day, to take time for yourself Charity day to volunteer and support a registered charity of your choice Westfield Health (including Health Club discount and Westfield Rewards discount and cashback) Learning and Development opportunities, with opportunities for internal mobility across various departments / areas of the business 4 x annual salary death in service life assurance Enhanced pension after long service Enhanced parental and adoption leave after long service Quarterly awards designed to reward and recognise our wonderful Twinkl employees Free Twinkl Subscription At Twinkl, we encourage diversity, and our doors are open to everyone. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. If you need any adjustments during the application process to showcase your abilities, please let us know. We're here to support you on your journey. We understand that great ideas aren't confined to an office. That's why our tech teams embrace a remote-friendly culture, giving you the flexibility to choose where you work best. Whether it's from our amazing HQ in Sheffield, mainly remote or something in-between, believe that your best work happens when you have the freedom to create your ideal workspace.
